justification: Critical: fixes a live overstatement in the buildable-area arithmetic introduced by #1255, adds per-control coverage findings (migration 106) and two Bayside rules (107), and changes the DQ-142 probe.

pre_impl.existing_data: DQ-142 read 14 after #1255; the last gaps were single controls a DCP does not set (footprint caps, one front setback, three City of Sydney secondary-dwelling setbacks) and Ashfield's rear setback.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: #1255 tied the footprint to the gap text: with a coverage finding present and a setback missing, the else-branch published a footprint with the missing setback as 0. It did not fire on #1255's own data (those pairs had no setbacks at all) but would on per-control findings.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: dcp_dev_type_coverage gains a nullable control_type (NULL = whole type); the lookup returns every finding for the pair and the arithmetic shows those for missing setbacks or the whole type.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Each finding was checked by two readings of the chapter; every quoted sentence was matched in the stored chapter text before the migration was written; floor-area limits were not treated as footprint caps.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend type change: findings arrive as gap strings the card already renders; the lookup now returns a list.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Without the fix, a council with a recorded finding and a missing setback would show a footprint too large; five findings were switched off in production until this ships.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_constraint_arithmetic.py -q -k Coverage ; python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-142
falsifiable_check.fails_when: A footprint is published while any setback is missing, a finding for one control is shown for another, or a finding hides a real gap in DQ-142.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Observed 2026-10-10: test_a_per_control_finding_is_shown_only_for_its_missing_control failed with buildable_footprint_m2 448.8 (expected None) on the #1255 code -- the overstatement. Five production findings whose pair holds some but not all setbacks were switched off at once; after the fix the test passes (119). The first probe edit excluded a whole pair for any finding; corrected to per-control. DQ-32b flagged 'C2' (a control number) and was recorded as reviewed.

functions.name: compute_constraint_arithmetic
functions.input: lot and LEP inputs, the DCP controls, and the list of coverage findings for this council and housing type
functions.output: the arithmetic result; the footprint is set only when every setback is stated; findings for missing setbacks explain the gap
functions.if_none: With no findings the generic gap text is used; the footprint is withheld either way when a setback is missing.

functions.name: _fetch_dcp_coverage
functions.input: a former-council slug and the housing type being computed, such as fairfield and secondary_dwelling
functions.output: every current coverage finding for that pair, whole-type findings first, each with its control_type
functions.if_none: None when no finding exists or the lookup fails; the caller shows the generic gap text.

values.value: 11 per-control coverage findings and 2 Bayside secondary-dwelling rules
values.source: council DCP chapters read 2026-10-10, nearest sentence quoted where it exists
values.read_at: constraint-arithmetic endpoint and the intelligence brief

queries.purpose: coverage findings for one council and housing type

queries.where_clause: cv.is_current AND cv.council = n.lga AND cv.dev_type = n.dev_type AND cv.control_type = n.ctl

break_it.scenario: A coverage finding exists and one setback is missing while the others are stated
break_it.what_happens: The footprint is withheld; only the explanation text changes to the finding
break_it.how: footprint set only when no setback is missing

break_it.scenario: A finding about the footprint cap is shown as the reason for a missing setback
break_it.what_happens: Not shown: only findings for the missing setbacks or the whole type are listed

break_it.scenario: A finding for one control hides other genuinely missing controls of the same pair in DQ-142
break_it.what_happens: Only the exact (council, housing type, control) recorded is excluded from the count
break_it.how: per-control NOT EXISTS in the probe

break_it.scenario: The findings are switched back on before the fixed code is deployed
break_it.what_happens: Migration 108 states it must only run after deploy; until then the five stay off and the generic text shows
break_it.how: separate migration, run by hand after deploy

break_it.scenario: A DCP control number such as 'C2' is read as a zone code and flagged
break_it.what_happens: Recorded as reviewed in the DQ-32b exclusion list with the reason

post_merge.manual_verify: After the API deploys this fix: python scripts/apply_migration_dry_run.py migrations/108_reenable_coverage_after_fix.sql --apply ; then python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-142 reads 1.

Applied to production 2026-10-10 after a rolled-back dry run (11 findings).
